_comment: Single source of truth for every citation the decks render (D101).
Each entry records where the citation itself comes from, so a reference on
a slide can be traced to the project record that verified it rather than to
whoever typed the slide. `status` is the honest part: `verified` means the
citation was checked at source (CrossRef, or the document's own title page);
`identifier_only` means the governing passage is quoted at first hand in
docs/vignettes_compendium.md but no formal citation has been written yet.
